use_case_summary: SableBridge needs an enterprise RAG stack for compliance/legal discovery. Primary flow: user query -> dense retrieval over 250M doc embeddings -> BM25/lexical hybrid for recall -> lightweight reranker on top-10 -> structured answer + provenance. Requirements: VPC/private control plane, audit logs shipped to customer SIEM, KMS BYOK, 7-year retention policy enforcement, predictable cost per query at 50 qps.
technical_requirements: Index scale target: 250,000,000 documents (avg doc size 3KB)
Embedding method: 1536-d dense vectors; prefer open quantized models for cost
Latency SLO: 95th percentile end-to-end under 350ms for query with reranking (target 200-300ms)
Throughput: baseline 50 qps sustained, burst to 200 qps
Caching: prefix/KV caching required for hot queries
Reranker: runs on CPU/GPU mix depending on model size; prefer dynamic fallback to lighter reranker on heavy load
Audit: immutable logs, tamper-evident, export to SIEM and long-term archive
Data residency: partitioned indices for EMEA and NA, must support region pinning
procurement_notes: Procurement expects PO and SOW. POC covers functionality, security attach, and cost model. Legal negotiating standard enterprise terms + encryption addendum.
commercial_notes: ARR upside if Dedicated/Private selected across 3 lines of business. Interested in committed capacity pricing for predictable unit economics.
implementation_risks: Indexing time for full corpus (est. 3-4 weeks with current pipeline)
Unexpected cost if reranker runs on large model without quantization/fallback
SSO attribute mapping complexity for cross-tenant access control
